# Hongkun Wang (王泓坤) — CV

> Digital Development Manager and full-stack engineer based in Shanghai, China. Specializes in TypeScript / React / Next.js, Node.js / FastAPI, and LLM / RAG applications. As the first engineer of Moidas' Greater China division, built the brand's official website & membership platform, unified SSO, AI skincare advisor, WeChat AI customer service, brand authorization platform, AI skin-analysis mini-program, and member-center mini-program from the ground up — 7 core systems within 12 months, backed by 2,900+ automated test cases.

## 中文摘要

王泓坤，常驻上海的数字开发经理、全栈工程师，专注 TypeScript / React / Next.js 与 AI / RAG。作为 Moidas（NIHPLOD）大中华区首位工程师，12 个月内从零搭建并上线 7 个核心系统、2,900+ 自动化测试，覆盖品牌官网与会员平台、统一认证（SSO）、AI 护肤顾问、企微 AI 客服、授权验真平台、AI 测肤小程序与会员中心小程序，并构建 SEO / GEO / AEO 搜索与 AI 可发现性体系。详见 [简体中文简历](https://cv.wilboerht.com/CV-cn/)。
